title: Optimizing Cough Rehabilitation Through Combined Cough Skill Training and Transcutaneous Spinal Cord Stimulation
official: Optimizing Cough Rehabilitation Through Combined Cough Skill Training and Transcutaneous Spinal Cord Stimulation
summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to evaluate the effects of combining cough training with low-level electrical stimulation to the neck (tsDCS) in healthy adults and adults with neurological diseases. The main questions it aims to answer are:

* Is using tsDCS during cough training safe, tolerable, and acceptable to participants?
* What tsDCS settings are most effective for pairing with cough training? Researchers will compare sham stimulation with active tsDCS to see if tsDCS enhances cough gains. Before and after each testing session, participants will complete breathing, coughing, and respiratory-strength training.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Forced vital capacity (FVC) ≥ 80% predicted based on age/sex

Exclusion Criteria:

* neurological disease
* respiratory disease including acute respiratory infection with cough during past week
* Pregnancy
* metallic implants in the spine
* cardiac pacemaker
* use of sodium channel blockers, calcium channel blockers, and/or NMDA receptor antagonists
